title: NeuralSRender: G-Buffer Guided Video Diffusion for Sim-to-Real Rendering
title_zh: NeuralSRender：G-Buffer引导的面向Sim-to-Real渲染的视频扩散

paragraphs.en: 提出NeuralSRender框架，用G-buffer引导视频扩散将模拟驾驶视频转换为逼真视频并提升感知性能。 The scarcity of high-quality annotated visual data remains a critical bottleneck for autonomous-driving perception. Simulators provide training data at scale, but the limited realism of synthetic videos compromises perception performance in real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose NeuralSRender, a sim-to-real video translation framework that enhances the photorealism of synthetic videos while maintaining geometric consistency with the source scenes. Built on a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT), NeuralSRender uses a lightweight projector to inject geometric and material priors from G-buffers, and LoRA enables parameter-efficient adaptation. The model is trained in two stages: it first learns G-buffer conditioning from synthetic videos with accurate G-buffers, then adapts to real-world appearance using real videos with estimated G-buffers. During the second stage, an additional LoRA module is trained while the projector and first-stage LoRA remain frozen to reduce interference from estimation noise. NeuralSRender introduces only 1.45\% parameter overhead and can be trained on consumer-grade GPUs with 24 GB of memory. To support training and evaluation, we introduce GenReal, a large-scale driving video dataset comprising synthetic and real-world videos with corresponding G-buffers. Experiments demonstrate improved photorealism with competitive geometric consistency. Training perception models on our translated videos instead of raw simulator renders improves detection $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ on nuImages from 35.1 to 40.6 and segmentation mIoU on Cityscapes from 32.4 to 40.8. Our code, data, and model weights are available at: https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender.
paragraphs.zh: 提出NeuralSRender框架，用G-buffer引导视频扩散将模拟驾驶视频转换为逼真视频并提升感知性能。高质量标注视觉数据的稀缺仍然是自动驾驶感知的关键瓶颈。 模拟器可以大规模提供训练数据，但合成视频逼真度的不足会损害真实场景应用中的感知性能。 为解决这一局限，我们提出NeuralSRender，一个从模拟到现实的视频转换框架，在提升合成视频照片级真实感的同时保持与源场景的几何一致性。 NeuralSRender构建于预训练的视频扩散Transformer（DiT）之上，使用轻量级投影器从G-buffer中注入几何与材质先验，并通过LoRA实现参数高效的适配。 该模型分两个阶段训练：首先从具有精确G-buffer的合成视频中学习G-buffer条件控制，然后利用带有估计G-buffer的真实视频适配真实世界的外观。 在第二阶段，仅训练一个额外的LoRA模块，而投影器和第一阶段的LoRA保持冻结，以减少估计噪声带来的干扰。 NeuralSRender仅引入1.45\%的参数开销，并可在配备24 GB显存的消费级GPU上训练。 为支持训练与评估，我们推出了GenReal，一个大规模驾驶视频数据集，包含合成视频与真实视频及相应的G-buffer。 实验表明，该方法在提升照片级真实感的同时保持了具有竞争力的几何一致性。 使用我们转换后的视频而非原始模拟器渲染结果来训练感知模型，可将nuImages上的检测 $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ 从35.1提升至40.6，将Cityscapes上的分割mIoU从32.4提升至40.8。 我们的代码、数据和模型权重发布于：https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender。
